announcement.feature2: <bold>คำสั่งทับที่กำหนดเอง</bold>: สร้างคำสั่งทับส่วนบุคคลเพื่อการเข้าถึงพรอมต์และเวิร์กโฟลว์ที่ใช้บ่อยได้อย่างรวดเร็ว พร้อมการจัดการ UI เต็มรูปแบบ

cloudAgents.heading: New in the Cloud:
cloudAgents.specialized: Introducing <bold>Explainer</bold>, <bold>Planner</bold>, and <bold>Coder</bold> - three specialized cloud agents to enhance your workflows.
cloudAgents.description: The agents work together in the cloud and can be triggered from the web or through Slack.

release.heading: What's New:
release.contextRewind: Improved context condensing now lets you restore the full previous context when rewinding to a checkpoint
release.ModelHarborProvider: ModelHarbor Agent Cloud provider now preserves reasoning content and defaults to native tools for better performance

stealthModel.feature: <bold>Limited-time FREE stealth model</bold> - Code Supernova: Now upgraded with a <bold>1M token context window</bold>! A versatile agentic coding model that supports image inputs, accessible through ModelHarbor Cloud.
stealthModel.note: (Note: prompts and completions are logged by the model creator and used to improve the model)
stealthModel.selectModel: Select modelharbor/code-supernova from the ModelHarbor Cloud provider in Settings to get started.
